worldcombat.skill.dive.summary: Dive only in a real water body that can hold the body: the user sinks first, then moves segment by segment through a connected water route up to the current range, and at the water's edge or the locked point bursts out along a real short exit segment. A hit deals physical damage, flings the target upward and pushes it back, and puts out its fire; an empty spot only repositions the user. The route telegraphs the landing, so a wall or cliff that cuts the route, or a target that leaves the lock radius, makes the strike miss; on a miss the user stays at the real safe point in water and is never teleported to fill the gap. The in-water bonus only holds in water, and soft ground no longer counts as a deep dive.
worldcombat.skill.dive.use.0: Flank through a real water route
worldcombat.skill.dive.use.1: Submerge, close in, then burst out at the water's edge
worldcombat.skill.dive.use.2: Advance in water and interrupt with the burst
worldcombat.skill.dive.description.0: The surfacing strike deals %1$s physical damage and throws the target about %2$s blocks upward and %3$s blocks back through native hit displacement, so a knockback-resistant body is still hurt but pushed less; if the target is carrying a burn, the bursting water puts it out.
worldcombat.skill.dive.description.1: The user sinks, waits %1$s ticks, then advances along the real water route; the burst covers about %2$s blocks around the landing. Firing in water raises damage, launch and knockback by %3$s%%.
worldcombat.skill.dive.description.2: Only a real water body that can hold the body allows the dive: the user sinks, then moves segment by segment through the connected route with real collision. The landing is locked when the dive begins, so a wall or cliff that cuts the route, or a target that leaves the lock radius, makes the strike miss. The surfacing follows the body's real arrival at the water's edge, and the splash is resolved there; on a miss the user stays at the real safe point in the water and is never teleported to fill the gap. The water also puts out the user's and the target's burn; an empty-spot aim only repositions.
worldcombat.skill.dive.stance.deep: Deep dive: longer range, higher damage, launch and knockback, but a longer dive and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.dive.stance.rush: Rush: shorter range, lower damage, launch and knockback, but a fast dive and cooldown for close pressure.
worldcombat.skill.dive.timing: Recovers for %1$s s after firing, spends %2$s PP, with a %3$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.dive.growth.0: At level %1$s the knockback rises to %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.dive.growth.1: At level %1$s the knockback rises further to %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.dive.preference.deep.h: On (deep dive): longer range, longer dive and water route, more damage, launch and knockback, but a longer cooldown. Off (rush): shorter range, damage, launch and knockback, but a fast dive and cooldown for close pressure. Only in water.
worldcombat.skill.dive.preference.ai.max: How far a foe may be before the companion considers Dive; lower keeps it close, higher lets it chase.
worldcombat.skill.dive.preference.ai.lea: When on, a stationed companion leaves its post to ambush a foe.
worldcombat.skill.dive.preference.ai.ope: With "Only isolated", the companion dives only when no other enemy is within 4 blocks of the target, instead of plunging into a crowd.
